faqs.q: Are these Coconut Chips sweetened or salted?
faqs.a: Neither! They are 100% pure unsweetened, unsalted mature coconut ribbons—just natural coconut flavor and crunch.

faqs.q: Can I toast these Coconut Chips at home?
faqs.a: Yes, tossing them in a dry pan on low heat for 60–90 seconds turns them golden-brown and brings out an intense toasted coconut aroma for desserts and granola.

faqs.q: How is this different from whole dry coconut (सूखा नरिवल / गडी) sold in markets?
faqs.a: Whole market dry copra is often smoke-dried or stored in humid sacks where mold can develop inside the shell. Our Coconut Chips are hygienically shaved from fresh white kernels and dehydrated cleanly so every piece is ready to eat.

faqs.q: Can I blend these chips with warm water to make quick coconut milk?
faqs.a: Yes! Blend 1/2 cup of Coconut Chips with 1.5 cups of warm water for 2 minutes and strain through a clean cloth for fresh homemade coconut milk.
